taittiriya_chapter2_verse1.title: Taittiriya Chapter 2 Verse 1
taittiriya_chapter2_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Taittiriya, Chapter 2.
taittiriya_chapter2_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Taittiriya Upanishad, Chapter 2, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
taittiriya_chapter2_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
